title: Deontic statement
description: A norm transcribed into a deontic formula: an operator over a (bearer : action) pair, with optional condition and exception. Structured projection of the canonical grammar. No inference is implied.

operator.description: The deontic modality: O obligation, P permission, F prohibition. "Right" is not a modality — it is a Hohfeldian incident (see incident).

condition.description: Applicability antecedent; non-empty makes the norm conditional.

exception.description: Defeasibility carve-out; non-empty makes the norm defeasible.

negated.description: True when the operator scopes a negative proposition (¬action).

incident.description: The Hohfeldian position the norm creates, from the addressee's perspective. '' = not classified (abstention, never a guess).

counterparty.description: The correlative role (claim-holder / party exposed to a power) when the norm names it.
